---
name: Infrastructure Enhancement Proposal
about: Suggest an architectural improvement or new AWS resource module
title: '[FEAT]: '
labels: enhancement, architecture
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the limitation or architectural gap (e.g., "RDS is currently Single-AZ", "Backend ALB is public instead of internal").

**Proposed Solution**
Describe the architectural or Terraform change you want implemented.

**Alternative Approaches Considered**
A clear description of any alternative solutions or tools considered.

**Security & Cost Implications**
- Security impact (e.g., changes to security groups, IAM policies, public subnets)
- Estimated monthly cost variation (e.g., Multi-AZ RDS doubles DB compute cost)
